CREATE FUNCTION private.payroll_draft_source_fingerprint(cid uuid,wid uuid,month date)
RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path='' AS $source$
 SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object(
 'company',(select to_jsonb(c) from public.companies c where id=cid),
 'worker',(select to_jsonb(w) from public.workers w where id=wid and company_id=cid),
 'settings',(select to_jsonb(s) from public.worker_payroll_settings s where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid),
 'attendance',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.id) from public.attendance_entries a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid and work_date>=month and work_date<(month+interval '1 month')::date),
 'leave',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by to_jsonb(a)::text) from public.paid_leave_requests a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid and leave_date>=month and leave_date<(month+interval '1 month')::date),
 'adjustments',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.id) from public.payroll_adjustments a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid and effective_date>=month and effective_date<(month+interval '1 month')::date),
 'unit_conditions',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.starts_on) from payroll_unit_private.conditions a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid),
 'unit_quantities',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.item_id) from payroll_unit_private.quantities a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid and a.month=$3),
 'resident',resident_tax_private.resolve(cid,wid,month),
 'tax_conditions',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.starts_on) from payroll_tax_private.worker_conditions a where company_id=cid and worker_id=wid),
 'rate_history',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by to_jsonb(a)::text) from payroll_rate_private.history a where company_id=cid),
 'income_table',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.calendar_year,a.lower_yen) from payroll_tax_private.monthly_income_rows a),
 'site_preferences',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.site_id) from public.site_calculation_source_preferences a where company_id=cid and output_type='payroll'),
 'trade_companies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.id) from public.trade_companies a where company_id=cid),
 'trade_contracts',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.trade_company_id) from public.trade_company_contracts a where company_id=cid)
 )::text)
$source$;
